entries.title: Industries of Titan
entries.definitive_edition: Industries of Titan on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Industries of Titan is an industrial city-building sim/strategy game from Brace Yourself Games. The 1.0 release date is January 31, 2023, after Early Access, with a Windows early-access history preceding it. It has Windows requirements and a soundtrack DLC, with no console, Mac, or Linux release found. Windows PC is the definitive route because it is the release platform and the only route with confirmed current availability.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam build. The OST is optional and not gameplay content, so no secondary route is required.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release; the 1.0 date is January 31, 2023, with Windows-only system requirements.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform release in this pass; no gameplay DLC or platform-exclusive content was found.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content or remaster split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive-edition split was found. The listed DLC is soundtrack content, not a gameplay expansion.
